messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert triggered for prod-us-west-2: multiple GV100 GPUs showing fragmentation-driven OOMs in kv-cache arena (INC-2026-245). Agent: batcher-service. Root group: continuous-batching. thread created 1898765432
pagerduty: Paging -> @oncall_sre (primary) @alex_chang (secondary) :bell:
oncall_sre: I'm on it, joining call. Can someone drop the earliest error logs and affected deploys?
alex_chang: Seeing lots of `c10::cuda::allocator::out_of_memory` and `arena allocation failed` in the runtime logs starting ~1898765400. Affected model: llama-3-70b-quant (kv-cache enabled).
priya_singh: We're seeing request error rate bump to ~3.5%  for GET /v1/generate in prod-us-west-2 over the last 10m. Latency also spiked from p95 120ms -> 2.3s. CS: Maria, any customer reports?
maria_cs: A few customers in org-452 reported degraded chat responses, no major revenue hits yet. I've opened support ticket TKT-1142 and notified the top 3 affected accounts.
raul_matos: Quick note: I pushed a batcher config change yesterday to increase continuous_batch_size to 16 and kv_arena_snap_threshold to 0.6 for throughput. Suspect compaction cadence got worse with larger batches.
oncall_sre: Can we confirm memory fragmentation per-GPU? Please paste `nvidia-smi dmon` snapshot and the process-level RSS from the runtime.
eng-runtime-bot: Automated snippet from host ip-10-0-32-101:
```
GPU,memUsed,memFree
GPU0,14520,235
GPU1,14280,475
GPU2,14800,120
```
Top process: python3 (batcher) alloc ~14.5GB with repeated cudaMalloc calls.
```
E 1898765416 runtime.cpp: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory (fragmentation)
E 1898765417 kv_arena.cpp: request 128MB failed, arena free blocks: 3x32MB, 1x16MB
```

alex_chang: Yup fragmentation: free blocks are split into small slabs after many variable-length KV inserts/evicts. PyTorch caching + backend allocator not coalescing.
priya_singh: Initial mitigation idea: reduce continuous_batch_size from 16 -> 8 and enable aggressive arena compaction (kv_arena_compact_interval=30s) to force coalescing. Can we apply a hotfix to dedicated prod pools? Risk: throughput may drop.
raul_matos: I can stage a config change on a single canary host in us-west-2. Command to update k8s config: `kubectl patch deployment batcher --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"batcher","env":[{"name":"CONT_BATCH_SIZE","value":"8"},{"name":"KV_ARENA_COMPACT_INTERVAL","value":"30"}]}}]}}}'`
oncall_sre: Do a canary on node ip-10-0-32-215 only. Watch for OOMs and p95 latency. Keep traffic split 5% to the canary.
alex_chang: Canary applied at 1898765605. Watching logs. No new cudaMalloc OOMs on canary in last 5m. p95 on canary steady ~140ms.
maria_cs: Reporting back to customers: one org acknowledged improvement in one host but still saw intermittent failures — they’re happy we're rolling a fix.
priya_singh: Roll hotfix to remaining nodes with staged ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, 5m windows. Rollback plan: revert env vars to previous values.
eng-runtime-bot: Executing staged rollout. Step 1 -> 5% completed at 1898765830. Step 2 -> 25% at 1898765940.
oncall_sre: Monitoring metrics: error rate dropped from 3.5% -> 0.6% after hitting 60% rollout. GPU mem fragmentation markers (internal metric kv.arena.fragmentation_ratio) fell from 0.78 -> 0.34.
alex_chang: Noticed increased kernel churn due to more frequent compaction but acceptable. Need follow-up: adjust default kv_arena_snap_threshold down to 0.5 for next release and add an adaptive compaction that triggers when fragmentation_ratio > 0.6.
raul_matos: Follow-up patch queued: PR #4021 adds adaptive compaction + a diagnostic flag to dump free block histograms. I'll add a unit test to reproduce fragmentation pattern.
maria_cs: CS notes: ~12 customers saw transient failures, 3 customers opened tickets. No SLA credits expected but ops wants postmortem text.
oncall_sre: Post-incident checklist: 1) Confirm rollout full at 1898766010. 2) Re-run heap analyzer to capture free-block histogram (store in s3://redwood-ops/incidents/INC-2026-245/). 3) Schedule a runbook update for kv_arena tuning. 4) Notify infra owners for allocator review.
alex_chang: I uploaded the heap dump and block histogram to s3 (link dropped in private thread). Sample snippet:
```
Free blocks: [32MB x 12, 16MB x 8, 8MB x 2, 4MB x 0]
Largest contiguous: 32MB
Avg fragmentation_ratio: 0.36
```

oncall_sre: Confirmed: rollout reached 100% at 1898766010, errors stabilized around 0.2%. Closing page. Will open a postmortem with RCA: kv-cache fragmentation exacerbated by larger continuous_batch_size + delayed compaction -> repeated cudaMalloc small allocations -> fragmentation-driven OOMs.
maria_cs: I'll prepare templated customer communication and attach incident timeline and mitigations.
raul_matos: Next actions (owners): Raul: PR for adaptive compaction; Alex: change default batcher config and run perf regression suite; Priya: update runbook and add emergency k8s patch commands.
oncall_sre: Thank you everyone. Marking incident resolved but keeping PR/retrospective on deck. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-245 status: resolved at 1898766123. Duration ~16m. Severity: Sev2.
